name: r7-auth-password
description: Plaintext password_hash stored as TEXT with invalid UTF-8: sign-in compares the decoded string; the rehash and password-change UPDATEs bind the decoded value and match no row. Record without --scoped.

steps.sql: SELECT id, hex(password_hash) AS h, typeof(password_hash) AS t FROM users WHERE id IN (1,260,261,262) ORDER BY id
SELECT key FROM app_settings WHERE key LIKE 'local_password_change_required:%' ORDER BY key
